title: Builder cutover diff (legacy → rebuild)
description: Advisory diff artifact emitted alongside a builder rewire under STRAT §10.4 row §D1 (= A1 1:1) or §D7 (G1 PARTIAL [BINDING]). Each diff covers one rebuilt artifact: legacy_only lists keys present only in the pre-rewire output, rebuild_only lists keys present only in the post-rewire output, and keyed_diff lists keys present in both with field-level differences. Summary counts mirror the array lengths and are surfaced verbatim in DONE-marker prose for PR review.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the diff shape changes in a way readers must observe.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced the diff.

artifact.description: Build-relative path of the rebuilt artifact this diff covers (e.g., gazetteers/institutions.json).

legacy_only_count.description: Number of keys present in the legacy output only.

rebuild_only_count.description: Number of keys present in the rebuild output only.

keyed_diff_count.description: Number of keys present in both outputs with field-level differences.

legacy_only.description: Keys present only in the legacy (pre-rewire) output, sorted ascending for determinism.

rebuild_only.description: Keys present only in the rebuild (post-rewire) output, sorted ascending for determinism.

keyed_diff.description: Entries present in both outputs but with field-level differences. Sorted by key for determinism.

key.description: The shared identifier between legacy and rebuild entries (e.g., institution name).

legacy.description: The legacy entry payload. Shape is determined by the artifact being diffed; the schema accepts any JSON value.

rebuild.description: The rebuild entry payload. Shape is determined by the artifact being diffed; the schema accepts any JSON value.
